sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at The Sandbach Community Football Centre on Saturday 19 September at 15:00 in a third-versus-fourth clash. The hosts arrive on a five-game unbeaten run (most recently drawing) and will look to capitalise on their home form, while Eccleshall, currently fourth with 18 points, will seek to upset the hosts and extend their own four-game winning streak.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth and Stafford Town both sit level on 19 points at the top of the table and will look to maintain their positions this weekend. Eccleshall's visit to Sandbach is the standout fixture at the upper end of the table. At the bottom, struggling Widnes Town travel to Foley Meir at the Trentham Foods Stadium, while fellow relegation-form sides Alsager Town (on the road at Allscott Heath) and Cheadle Heath Nomads (hosting in-form Stafford Town) will be desperate to pick up points. Allscott Heath come into their match against Alsager having secured an impressive 7–1 away win last weekend. The remaining fixtures see Bilston Town face Market Drayton Town, Brereton Social host AFC Bridgnorth, Crewe entertain Wednesfield Community, New Mills travel to Dawley Town, Shawbury United host Wolverhampton Casuals, and Telford Town face Barnton.
